meta.name: monitoring-expert
meta.description: Configures monitoring systems, implements structured logging pipelines, creates Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, defines alerting rules, and instruments distributed tracing. Implements Prometheus/Grafana stacks, conducts load testing, performs application profiling, and plans infrastructure capacity. Use when setting up application monitoring, adding observability to services, debugging production issues with logs/metrics/traces, running load tests with k6 or Artillery, profiling CPU/memory bottlenecks, or forecasting capacity needs.

copy.tagline: 配置监控系统、日志管道和告警规则，快速定位生产问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在服务中搭建可观测性体系并快速诊断故障
copy.tagline_en: Set up monitoring, logging pipelines, and alerting to quickly debug production issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build observability into your services and diagnose issues fast

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为你的应用配置监控：添加结构化日志、指标和追踪，搭建 Prometheus/Grafana 看板，编写警报规则，并支持负载测试、性能剖析和容量规划。
howto.when: 当你要求设置监控、调试生产问题、做负载测试等，或提到 Prometheus、Grafana 等工具时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Node.js 服务加 pino 结构化日志和请求 ID。
say.note: Claude 会给出代码示例和接入步骤。

say.text: 为我的 API 配置 Prometheus 指标和 Grafana 仪表盘。
say.note: 它会生成指标采集代码和仪表盘配置。

say.text: 用 k6 写负载测试脚本，要求 p95 小于 500ms。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试脚本和阈值断言。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude configures monitoring for your app: adds structured logging, metrics, and tracing; builds Prometheus/Grafana dashboards; writes alert rules; and supports load testing, profiling, and capacity planning.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to set up monitoring, debug production issues, run load tests, or mention tools like Prometheus, Grafana.

say_en.text: Add pino structured logging and request IDs to this Node.js service.
say_en.note: Claude provides code and setup steps.

say_en.text: Set up Prometheus metrics and a Grafana dashboard for my API.
say_en.note: It generates metric code and dashboard config.

say_en.text: Write a k6 load test with p95 under 500ms.
say_en.note: Claude creates the script and thresholds.
